name: @redis-x/client
description: Enhanced redis client built on top of "redis" package.

scripts.build: bun run build:lib && bun run build:package
scripts.build:lib: bun run build/main.ts && bunx biome format src/client.ts src/transaction.ts src/transaction/use.ts --write
scripts.check: bun run build:lib && bun run lint && bun run build:package && bun run test
scripts.lint: lint && bun run lint:ts:build && bun run lint:ts:test
scripts.redis:up: docker ps | grep test-redis >/dev/null || docker run --rm -d -p 16379:6379 --name test-redis redis:7-alpine
scripts.test: bun run redis:up && npm run test:vitest && bun test --coverage

author: Daniil Kirichenko (https://twitter.com/kirickme)
